rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Anastasia (hybrid tea, Greff 1980)
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. None / no fragrance. 30 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Notes: Michael at Michael's Premier Roses says there aren't too many white roses that do well in the heat, but this one does. Plus its got great show form with long stems.
